cards.malformedCueText: not whether or not those practices would be justified
cards.replacementCueText: the question about whether certain types of reactive attitudes would be justified
cards.relationText: not whether or not those practices would be justified but the question about whether certain types of reactive attitudes would be justified
cards.rationale: The default is no reframe, but the explicit not-whether and but-question cues identify both demands and uniquely link them contrastively; exclusion does not apply because the replacement is distinct and express.

The default is no reframe, and the positive rule requires explicit cues for both a malformed demand and its replacement under one unique link; exclusion applies because the disfluent wording never states the rejected demand, while the later but-clause links claims rather than demands.
